title: feat(setup): Connect-an-agent page widget — mcp:connect-agent (#2363)
body:
Closes #2363 (framework#2714 Phase 1).

The `mcp:connect-agent` SDUI widget — the interactive body for the "Connect an agent" Setup page, whose metadata ships plugin-carried with `@objectstack/mcp` (framework PR pending; page + nav appear automatically once that lands, no console rebuild needed beyond this widget).

## What it does

- **MCP URL** from `/api/v1/discovery` → `routes.mcp`, absolute-resolved, with copy
- **Per-client cards**: claude.ai/Claude Desktop (paste URL + public-HTTPS reachability note), Claude Code (one-liner + official `objectstack-ai/claude-plugin` install), Cursor (one-click `Add to Cursor` deeplink with base64 config + JSON snippet), VS Code/Copilot (`.vscode/mcp.json`), Codex CLI (`config.toml` + API-key fallback note) — OAuth is the default story on every card
- **SKILL.md download** → `GET /api/v1/mcp/skill` (framework#2728)
- **API-key minting** (headless callers): existing `POST /api/v1/keys`, shown once with both raw and `x-api-key:` header forms
- **Disabled empty state** when discovery doesn't advertise `routes.mcp` (`OS_MCP_SERVER_ENABLED=false`) — mirrors the server, which 404s the surface
- **i18n**: all nine locales (the locale-parity test enforces it)

## Verification

- app-shell 1164 ✓, i18n 173 ✓ (incl. locale key-parity)
- Browser-verified against a live framework dev server (showcase, port 3210): page reachable from Setup nav under Integrations, all six cards render with the real environment URL injected, **API key minted on-page then used to drive a real MCP `tools/list` → all 9 tools**, SKILL.md link serves the env-customized markdown.

Screenshots in framework#2714 thread. Companion framework PR: connect-agent UI bundle (page metadata + nav, gated on the default-on MCP switch).
